description: This file defines the CandidateMenuConfigurator class, which implements menu configuration for the recruitment module in the OrangeHRM system. It uses traits and interfaces to modify the screen menu, specifically overriding the 'viewCandidates' screen for the current module.

classes.name: CandidateMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for the recruitment candidate menu, overriding the screen to 'viewCandidates'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the configure method to set the screen to 'viewCandidates' and returns null.
